record.paper_title: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About How Causal Set Theory Can Help with Open Questions in Cosmology, but Were Afraid to Ask
record.original_question: What fundamental quantum-gravity-compatible model explains the detailed nature of primordial quantum fluctuations and how those fluctuations lead to structure formation, rather than relying on inflaton-field models that have not yet been naturally connected to a more fundamental theory?

evidence.quote: One of the successes of quantum field theory in curved spacetime has been to generate a primordial power spectrum that closely agrees with the observed anisotropies in the cosmic microwave background.
The detailed nature of these fluctuations and how they lead to structure formation is still not well understood.
As mentioned above, we would like to have a model that naturally connects to a more fundamental theory, and so far that has been challenging to achieve with inflation.

artifact.status_search_result: No accepted quantum-gravity-derived model currently provides a first-principles, observationally validated account of primordial fluctuations and structure formation that supplants inflaton-based phenomenology. Candidate approaches (causal set theory, loop quantum cosmology, group field theory, string-gas cosmology, etc.) offer partial proposals but none is established as a complete solution; the problem is widely regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: Loop quantum cosmology: a status report
status_evidence.snippet: LQC provides modifications to the inflationary scenario but a complete derivation of the primordial spectrum from full quantum gravity remains incomplete.
status_evidence.claim: Quantum gravity approaches have not yet produced a complete, observationally confirmed alternative to inflaton-based predictions.
